summary: Keep browser shell readiness independent of outbox identity and storage initialization

replay.detail: No packet replay or delivery-certainty changes. Unknown attempts remain non-retryable.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The read-only shell and roster no longer wait for the channel capabilities probe or browser storage. Send grants and recovery still await scoped outbox initialization and current identity checks.

downtime.detail: No server interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: Outbox recovery remains asynchronous and scope-checked; initialization failures keep sending unavailable without blocking read-only page rendering.
